The '''Din Nebula''', known to the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]] as the '''Gorax King's Heart''', was a [[Color/Legends|red]]-colored [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]]. Along with the [[Din Pulsar/Legends|Din Pulsar]], it constituted the remains of the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Din]], which had [[Din supernova|exploded]] in a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. At some point, [[Survey droid/Legends|survey droids]] penetrated the Din Nebula and reached the [[Din system]].

==Description==
The Din Nebula was a part of the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]],<ref name="EAOC Din" /> one of the [[Sector/Legends|subsectors]] making up the [[Inner Zuma Region]]<ref name="TEA" /> within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Zuma sector/Legends|Zuma sector]].<ref name="EAOC Din" /> By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]],<ref name="Endor" /> which began in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] was an expanding [[Cloud/Legends|cloud]] of shimmering [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Gas/Legends|gases]], and it surrounded the [[Din Pulsar/Legends|Din Pulsar]].<ref name="Endor" />

==History==
[[File:EwokNEGAS.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Din Nebula featured in the mythology of the Ewoks.]]
The Din Nebula was formed around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], when the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Din]] of the [[Din system]] [[Din supernova|exploded]] in a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]]. During the [[Standard century/Legends|century]] leading up to the Yuuzhan Vong War, the combination of [[Magnet/Legends|magnetic]] pulses from the remaining [[Pulsar/Legends|pulsar]] and filaments of gas from the nebula made the adjacent [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Trindello-Endor Route]] increasingly unstable.<ref name="Endor" />

The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]] called the Din Nebula the Gorax King's Heart, in reference to a myth wherein their [[Ibleam|sun]] [[Deity/Legends|god]] [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] the being known as the [[Gorax King]] in the [[Local day/Legends|night]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|sky]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The Gorax King was said to have subsequently swallowed his most treasured possession, a large [[Diamond/Legends|diamond]], which reached his [[Heart/Legends|heart]] and remained in Endor's sky when the rest of the Gorax King's body melted away after his [[Death/Legends|death]]. At some point, [[Survey droid/Legends|survey droids]] penetrated the Din Nebula and made their way to the Din [[Star system/Legends|system]] where they discovered that, unusually, the stripped core of one of Din's former [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Planet/Legends|planets]] was indeed a diamond the size of a terrestrial world.<ref name="Endor" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Din Nebula was first mentioned in the article "[[Endor and the Moddell Sector]]," which was published in the [[Star Wars Gamer 9|ninth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine<ref name="Endor" /> on [[February 22]], [[2002]].<ref name="GamerDate">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20020222.html|text=Starfighters Soar in Gamer #9}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square H-16.<ref name="TEA" />
